rows.question: Does the Free plan include SAML single sign-on?

answer.answer: No. SAML 2.0 single sign‑on is available only on the Business plan; the Free plan does not include it.

citations.quote: SAML 2.0 single sign-on is available on the Business plan only.

rows.question: I'm on a monthly plan and cancel after 10 days. Do I get any money back?

answer.answer: No. For monthly plans, CloudSync does not provide partial‑month refunds. You can cancel anytime, but you keep access until the end of the paid month and receive no money back for the unused days.

citations.quote: Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time. Monthly plans do not receive partial-month refunds; access continues until the end of the paid month.

rows.question: What is the total cost of 3 Business users billed annually for 2 years?

answer.answer: The total cost for 3 Business users billed annually over 2 years is $1,224.

citations.quote: Business: ... Price is $20 per user per month when billed monthly, or $17 per user per month when billed annually.

rows.question: The customer in ticket T-1005 bought an annual plan 12 days ago. Are they eligible for a full refund?

answer.answer: Yes. The annual plan was purchased only 12 days ago, which is within the 30‑day window for a full refund.

citations.quote: Annual plans receive a full refund if you cancel within 30 days of purchase.

rows.question: How many devices can I sync on the Free plan?

answer.answer: I’m sorry, but the documentation does not specify a limit on the number of devices you can sync with the Free plan.

rows.question: Do I need to do anything if I see error E-5001?

answer.answer: For error E‑5001 (Server unavailable), you don’t need to take any action. The app will automatically retry with increasing delays. Only intervene if the error persists for more than 30 minutes.

citations.quote: E-5001: Server unavailable … the app retries automatically with increasing delays, so no action is needed unless the error lasts more than 30 minutes.

rows.question: What happens to my files while my account is read-only after a failed payment?

answer.answer: When a payment fails and your account becomes read‑only, all of your files remain safe and you can still download them. You just cannot make changes until the payment issue is resolved.

citations.quote: Files stay safe and downloadable while the account is read-only.
